incident: Reporting jobs consume all database connections
symptoms: scheduled jobs held many DB connections
connection wait time spiked during batch start
recent_changes: See root-cause context; synthetic historical incident.
root_cause: A new reporting job opened many concurrent database sessions and did not cap concurrency.
successful_steps: Killed only the runaway batch workers
resolution: A reporting batch exceeded safe DB connection concurrency. Limiting worker concurrency released enough connections for interactive traffic.
postmortem: Scaling reporting workers increased DB connection usage.
Timeout increases only hid the underlying contention.
